newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Telecel float heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Telecel float heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: The direct sale in the flotation of a stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel was 17 times oversubscribed and the public offer for sale (OPV) was three times oversubscribed, Lisbon bourse said.
Demand in the domestic and international direct sale was 124,421,116 shares and the available supply was 7,045,000 shares, the bourse said.
In the direct sale two million shares were sold in Portugal and 5,045,000 abroad.
Demand in the OPV was 1,928,190 shares and the available supply was 600,000 shares.
The flotation of up to 39.11 percent of Telecel, one of two mobile phone operators in Portugal, was priced at 7,950 escudos per share.
The flotation earned some 60.8 billion escudos, including 56 billion from the direct sale and 4.77 billion from the OPV.
Telecel employees bought 73,580 shares, clients bought 75,260 shares, distributors 9,830 shares and the general public 441,330 shares.
In the OPV there were 5,227 new shareholders, including 20 foreigners.
